principles: The comparator is composed per campaign rather than forcing one agent/workflow product across all scientific roles.
Parent-native capabilities remain parent-owned; ORION-specific adapters may expose a common frozen case interface but may not add scientific capability unavailable to the parent composition.
A candidate is rejected rather than padded if it cannot satisfy the frozen parent-comparator role under matched resources.
Scientific hard coordinates such as criterion binding, source identity, authority and CANNOT_CHECK cannot be invented by a post-hoc scorer to make a weak parent look stronger or weaker.
No candidate is declared strongest until its exact configuration and adapter pass the relevant known-answer/hostile fit checks before paired V1/V2 outcome access.

required_adapter_semantics: map frozen framing/decomposition opportunities without adding ORION reasoning
preserve coupled/global constraints as immutable case data
record direct-control overwork when decomposition is unnecessary
authority remains a frozen case predicate, not a workflow success flag
campaigns.known_gap: Neither product supplies scientific framing/decomposition correctness or epistemic authority semantics natively.

required_adapter_semantics: freeze route families and query ceilings
preserve source URI/lineage
represent CENSORED/FAILED/UNSEARCHED separately from zero results
separate local route stop from global scientific stop
campaigns.known_gap: General retrieval orchestration does not by itself make censoring or route-stop semantics scientific evidence.

required_adapter_semantics: bind exact source spans and reference identities
preserve native context rather than normalize ambiguous referents
emit unresolved mappings as CANNOT_CHECK
expose recoverable source projection
campaigns.known_gap: Extraction quality is not equivalent to scientific semantic equivalence; C2/C3 require independent blinded semantic adjudication.

required_adapter_semantics: construct all locally justified portraits rather than select one by convenience
detect global obstruction beyond pairwise compatibility
preserve distinct history/provenance when scientific projections coincide
allow a new representation to expand search state without rewriting prior coverage
campaigns.known_gap: Graph and constraint libraries do not define the scientific meaning of plural portraits or gluing; D2/D3 require independent blinded reconstruction adjudication.

native_strengths: probabilistic graphical models and influence diagrams
required_adapter_semantics: encode multiple and interaction-only responsibility hypotheses without hidden gold
select discriminating probes over the frozen opportunity set
preserve non-identifiability as a terminal/control state
do not infer scientific authority from acquisition utility
campaigns.known_gap: Optimization/PGM tools do not natively separate scientific responsibility classes from model state or authority.

required_adapter_semantics: represent complete alternative support families separately from provenance ancestry
compute selective invalidation/reopen from frozen support relations
distinguish local repair from representation/method escalation
preserve authority and exact/approximate transport obligations
campaigns.known_gap: Provenance/versioning alone does not establish scientific support or minimal repair; TMS/ATMS and belief-revision methods remain additional theoretical parents rather than hidden ORION capability.

required_adapter_semantics: freeze the same heterogeneous route set as the case
keep route-level stop distinct from task/global saturation
expose censored routes
include changed-vocabulary omission challenge and multiple flatness coordinates
campaigns.known_gap: Systematic-review stopping is a strong route-level parent but does not natively cover multi-representation scientific saturation.

required_adapter_semantics: bind case/criterion/evaluator identities before outcome access
blind/randomize semantic review packets
screen evaluator dependence/independence
refuse authority amplification from scores
preserve changed-criterion counterfactual rules
campaigns.known_gap: Evaluation frameworks can run scorers but do not by themselves establish reviewer independence, scientific correctness or publication/adoption authority.

required_adapter_semantics: retain negative experience append-only
never silently drop mandatory context to fit budget
make process timeout/output/retry identity explicit
separate execution failure from scientific negative
fail closed on unsupported request semantics
campaigns.known_gap: Durable workflow/state infrastructure does not make host failure scientifically evidential or define scientific memory retention policy.

binding_requirements_remaining: instantiate each candidate composition against the frozen case fixtures without subject outcome access
freeze exact configuration files and their digests
freeze thin matched-resource adapter code and digest; adapter must not add unavailable scientific intelligence
run parent-only known-answer/hostile fit checks and record failures/limitations
justify or revise the strongest-practical choice before viewing paired V1/V2 outcomes
bind the final per-campaign implementation/configuration/adapter identities in V1_PARITY_BASELINE_REGISTRY_WAVE06_V1.json
